【场景】夜晚城市街头，背景是暖黄色路灯与整齐的行道树，柏油路面有微弱反光
【角色】主角@图片1（身穿黑色大方领紧身长袖上衣，黑色长发自然垂落）

[00:00-00:02] 镜头1：橡胶大嘴拉扯与回弹（Rubber Mouth Stretch）
机位：中近景，手持自拍微仰视视角，镜头随呼吸轻微晃动。
动作：主角双手食指插进嘴角向两侧极度拉扯开，嘴巴像弹性橡胶一样被拉扯得巨大无比，吐出长舌头做搞怪鬼脸；双手松开后，嘴巴瞬间像弹簧一样恢复原状，主角歪头对着镜头微笑并轻快挥手。
特效：主角原本面部的超夸张物理弹性拉伸与回弹（Elastic Face Deformation），保持真人五官材质与肤质，无卡通替换。

[00:02-00:05] 镜头2：拍头变身大头娃娃（Giant Head Morphing）
机位：中近景，镜头中心平稳锁定在头部。
动作：主角双手抬起轻拍头部上方两侧。
特效：在手掌拍下的瞬间，主角原本的头部瞬间极度膨胀变大成“大头小子”造型，眼睛瞪大成凸起白眼珠，双颊鼓成圆球形嘟嘴，脖子与身体保持原样；随后双手放下，头部瞬间平滑缩回正常真人大小。

[00:05-00:07] 镜头3：提发纵向拉长脸部（Vertical Face Pull）
机位：中景，平稳手持视角。
动作：主角双手抓住头顶两撮头发向上快速提拉。
特效：在拉扯动作下，主角原有人脸被纵向极度拉长，五官随之拉伸变形为纵向椭圆大眼与“O”型嘴；双手松开时面部瞬间平滑收缩复原，主角低头腼腆眯眼甜笑。

[00:07-00:10] 镜头4：爪子咆哮与侧身定格（Playful Growl & Freeze）
机位：中景，镜头随动作有微小顿挫推镜感，最后平移定格。
动作：主角面部和身体保持完全正常的真人状态、无任何形变特效；双手抬至脸侧张开成“怪兽爪”姿态，仰头张嘴大笑做出“嗷呜”咆哮动作；随后身体向侧面微倾，收起双手，嘴角带笑侧身回眸直视镜头定格。
音效：配搞怪音效与清脆卡点音效。

Seedance 2.5 prompt ⬇️

【Style】Douyin viral funny elastic face FX short video (Viral Funny Elastic Face FX), live-action real scene, exaggerated rubber-level physical deformation FX, 4K ultra HD quality, night portrait lighting, clean image with no watermark or text
【Duration】10 seconds
【Scene】Night city street, background is warm yellow streetlights and neatly arranged street trees, asphalt road surface with faint reflections
【Character】Protagonist @图片1 (Image 1) (wearing a black large square-neck fitted long-sleeve top, black long hair naturally falling)

[00:00-00:02] Shot 1: Rubber mouth stretch and rebound (Rubber Mouth Stretch)
Camera: Medium close-up, handheld selfie slightly upward angle, camera slightly shakes with breathing.
Action: Protagonist inserts both index fingers into mouth corners and pulls extremely to both sides, mouth stretched enormous like elastic rubber, sticks out long tongue making a funny face; after releasing both hands, mouth instantly springs back to original shape, protagonist tilts head smiling at camera and lightly waves.
FX: Ultra-exaggerated physical elastic stretching and rebound of protagonist's original face (Elastic Face Deformation), maintaining real human facial feature materials and skin texture, no cartoon replacement.

[00:02-00:05] Shot 2: Head pat transforms into big-head doll (Giant Head Morphing)
Camera: Medium close-up, camera center steadily locked on the head.
Action: Protagonist raises both hands and lightly pats both sides above the head.
FX: At the instant the palms pat down, protagonist's original head instantly extremely expands into a “big-head kid” look, eyes bulging into protruding white eyeballs, cheeks puffing into round balls with pout, neck and body stay as original; then hands lower, head instantly smoothly shrinks back to normal real-human size.

[00:05-00:07] Shot 3: Hair lift vertically elongates face (Vertical Face Pull)
Camera: Medium shot, steady handheld angle.
Action: Protagonist grabs two tufts of hair on top of head and rapidly pulls upward.
FX: Under the pulling action, protagonist's original face is extremely elongated vertically, facial features stretch and deform into vertically oval big eyes and “O”-shaped mouth; when hands release, face instantly smoothly contracts and restores, protagonist lowers head shyly squinting with a sweet smile.

[00:07-00:10] Shot 4: Claw growl and side freeze (Playful Growl & Freeze)
Camera: Medium shot, camera has slight staccato push-in feel with the action, finally pans and freezes.
Action: Protagonist's face and body remain completely normal real-human state, no deformation FX; both hands raised to face sides opened into “monster claw” pose, head tilted back mouth open laughing making an “awoo” growl action; then body slightly leans to the side, hands withdrawn, corners of mouth smiling, side glance back directly at camera freeze.
Sound effects: Paired with funny sound effects and crisp beat-sync sound effects.
